conditional_reconstruction.classification: Model-derived values used for synthetic reproduction and bounded search; no incident RAM capture, savestate, or controller movie directly establishes them.

reconstruction_derivation.speed_setting: Inferred from the clock hand appearing within the stopped interval around 12 and from the supplied reconstruction TAS corpus; no incident RAM value survives.
reconstruction_derivation.spinner_identity: The published -4207.0 value equals -4233 + 26, the top plane of the spinner centered at (1102,-4233,1682), and the video appears consistent with that spinner. This is a model fit, not direct state evidence.
reconstruction_derivation.location: The video appears to place the event near the spinner end beside the red coin centered at (800,-4400,1900). Exact X/Z are unavailable because no original controller movie or RAM capture exists.
reconstruction_derivation.action: The lossy 29.97 fps VOD shows a landing followed by an airborne state before the transition. Stream frame loss prevents an exact game-update action assignment; ACT_FREEFALL and vertical velocity -20 are synthetic reconstruction inputs.

platform_pointer_cases: every active object slot for stale-pointer testing

supplied_tas_corpus.assessment: The movies are short variants from one pre-TTC savestate. They stop around the entrance floor near (1400,-4822,-520), never approach the incident spinner, and do not constrain incident X/Z, velocity, action, input, or platform-pointer state.

vod_rendered_candidate_fit.assessment: The three exact render sequences were not fitted to or excluded by the surviving pixels. Strict within-domain image diagnostics failed, but no known-positive VOD-to-Glide64mk2 transfer calibration exists; the Mario localizer also lacks an image-level cross-domain positive. The higher-resolution highlight aligned at offset -153 but failed its predeclared coverage-improvement gate, so it did not justify refitting the scenarios.

r4300_multiply_hazard_audits.assessment: The retained route has no adjacent multiply pair among its observed transitions. The matched JP ROM CPU .text scope plus one required boundary delay word contains no static back-to-back R4300 multiply-erratum pair under the recognized decoder, so no operand-value trace is needed for that static scope. Neither bounded result identifies or excludes a physical fault, and unrecognized control successors remain outside the static CFG proof.

evidence_limitations: No original savestate or RAM capture exists.
The legacy Google Drive package linked by the bounty is access-denied and could not be recovered from public archives.
The VOD is a lossy, composited 29.97 fps race stream and can omit N64 frames.
The exact pre-event Y word, spinner contact, TTC speed RAM value, action, velocity, camera, and game-update alignment are conditional reconstruction fields rather than direct observations.
The encoded-frame timing audit in results/vod_cadence_audit.json identifies frames on the YouTube timeline, not original N64 VIs or game updates.
The scene and Mario-motion fits of the three exact rendered scenarios remain indeterminate because calibrated cross-domain positives and dense transition localization are absent.
